cells.quote: The following results were observed for well-knotted knots: an average of 26,0% (19-41%) of good knots when performed with the right hand; 24.0% (22-26%) when performed with the left hand; 21,4% (18-23%) when performed with the needle at 45º and 28.6% (15-33%) when performed with the back hand. O.outcome_detail: improvement in CCUS knowledge test scores after 6 months

cells.quote: No statistically significant difference was observed between the 2 groups (Fig. 2): knowledge, median (IQR), 8.5 (2.5–15) versus 14 (5–21), P = 0.26; skill, 11 (0.5–19) versus 16 (2–30), P = 0.20; and total score, 18 (3.8–38) versus 31(21–46), P = 0.09.

cells.quote: No statistically significant difference was observed in the median (interquartile range [IQR]) improvement in CCUS proficiency tests between the ST group and the IT group: 18 (3.8–38) versus 31 (21–46) (P = .09).
